variable.name: CTYPE
variable.abstract: It defines the type of coordinates of the process

description.p: It allows to specify the kind of source of coordinates for the process, being affected the calculation of its positioning in screen.

Their values can be:
C_SCREEN makes reference to the coordinates of screen
C_SCROLL makes reference to the coordinates of a SCROLL zone
C_M7 makes reference to the coordinates of a Mode7 zone
The value by default is C_SCREEN, for other values must be specified in the variable the zones of SCROLL or Mode7 in which the process will be showed.
